subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about driving funded accounts for {Brand} in the UK, where the win is a user who opens, verifies, and actually loads money. The one point worth repeating: we optimize to the funded account itself and read it back through a server-to-server postback fired from your stack before it counts, so an opened-but-empty account never bills. At scale that holds around 1,400 funded accounts a day at wallet-grade funding quality. Worth a short look at the funded-account read?
angle: warm bump, restate funded-account postback proof
illustrative_flags: 1,400 funded accounts a day (MobUpps-specific daily funded-account volume; illustrative placeholder calibrated to the UK consumer-fintech wallet vertical)
register_notes: Stage 1 EN fintech wallet UK: references prior outreach in first sentence; restates single proof (optimize to funded account + S2S postback before billing); one illustrative MobUpps figure (1,400 funded accounts/day, flagged); soft CTA, exactly 1 question mark; no sign-off; native English; no em-dash; no 'X, not Y' (stated positively).
